deep_dive.title: Programmable Synthetic Motion at a Time-Varying Interface
deep_dive.abstract: Space-time metamaterials that exhibit synthetic motion promise arbitrary control over the momentum, frequency and energy of scattered light, but realising the required space-time modulation in a programmable way remains a challenge. Here we program synthetic motion using a single spatial light modulator in a 4f geometry which imprints a continuously tunable pulse-front tilt onto a high-intensity pump pulse, inducing reflectivity modulations at a sub-wavelength indium tin oxide thin film with synthetic velocities spanning the sub- and superluminal regimes. The angle-resolved spectrum of a scattered probe pulse reveals space-time diffraction patterns whose gradient and bandwidth vary continuously with synthetic velocity, in excellent agreement with theory. Splitting the shaped pump into two independently controlled pulses yields space-time double-slit diffraction with tunable fringe separation and frequency-momentum gradient. This programmable platform opens a path towards non-linear and periodic space-time trajectories for tabletop analogue studies of relativistic phenomena and space-time metasurfaces.

deep_dive.llm_tldr_en: This paper demonstrates programmable synthetic motion using an indium tin oxide thin film with a time-varying interface. A spatial light modulator imprints tunable pulse-front tilt onto a pump pulse, inducing reflectivity modulations across sub- and superluminal regimes, enabling space-time diffraction control.
deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 该研究利用铟锡氧化物薄膜在时变界面上实现可编程合成运动。通过空间光调制器在泵浦脉冲上施加可调脉冲波前倾斜，在亚光速和超光速范围内诱导反射率调制，实现对空间-时间衍射图案的连续控制，为时空超材料提供了灵活的实验平台。
